typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You arrive at the convention center lobby, palms sweaty and with a lump in your throat. You nearly broke the bank to make it, but here you are - the first Size Con. A convention formed as a way to share experiences, resources, and support between women around the world who have found themselves inflicted with Hyperism - a recent mutation that causes some women's bodies to overdevelop in various ways.*

*Everyone else seems a little on edge to be out and about in public - for many affected women, their size makes life difficult. You try not to gawk as two college students waddle past, nursing engorged pregnant bellies that nearly graze the floor. Across the hall another girl talks on the phone, her body entirely hidden beneath a collosal set of breasts that obscures her and project several feet out in all directions. And there are many more like them.*

*You should pick up your registration badge for the con before anything else. Why did you come here, and what do you do first?*
typesense:top-rated.name: SizeCon
typesense:top-rated.title: A convention for the strangely endowed.
